integrity: All displayed extrema are supported by an explicit proof and an independently reproducible finite checker. Source inspection does not establish absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Binary, linear, ordered length-two multispectra only; individual fixed-profile run-count formulas are classical. An earlier unpublished or unindexed extremal Markov-type result cannot be ruled out. Computations corroborate the all-length proof but are not infinite certificates.
title: Sharp worst-case ambiguity of binary two-gram multispectra
